title: Signature Stone-Free Bell
concept: A bell for passing or clearing kidney stones — the infamous pain, ended and celebrated. Relief, rung out. Concept by Manon.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on silent suffering with a victory ritual.
patient_flow: Patients arrive with stones, urinary symptoms, or elevated PSAs; CT scans, cystoscopy, and urodynamics define the problem. Many procedures are endoscopic — day surgery through the urethra. Stone patients get prevention workups; cancer patients get multidisciplinary oncology; BPH patients choose among medications, minimally invasive, and surgical options.
code_demo:
# Signature Stone-Free Bell — Signature design prototype
def ipss_score(answers):
    """International Prostate Symptom Score: 7 questions, 0-5 each."""
    total = sum(answers)
    band = "mild" if total <= 7 else "moderate" if total <= 19 else "severe"
    return f"IPSS {total}/35 -> {band} lower urinary tract symptoms"
print(ipss_score([3, 2, 4, 3, 2, 4, 3]))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
